137436.overview:
Yu Suzuki Game Works Vol. 1 (鈴木裕ゲームワークス Vol. 1) is a compilation of games designed by Yu Suzuki in the 1980s. It was released exclusively in Japan for the Sega Dreamcast in 2002, and came with a guide book. No second volume was ever released.

Games included:

After Burner II
Hang-On
OutRun
Power Drift
Space Harrier

146553.overview:
Sakura Wars 2: Thou Shalt Not Die (サクラ大戦2 〜君、死にたもうことなかれ〜), takes place in a renewed Teito Tokyo ("Imperial Capital Tokyo"), one years after Hanagumi Squad Leader Ichirou Ohgami returned to the Imperial Navy. 
Returning from a Pacific-to-Atlantic shakedown cruise, Ensign Ohgami is reassigned to lead the Hanagumi ("Flower Division") of the Imperial Assault Force (Teikoku Kagekidan), defending the capital from mysterious new demonic forces, this time with a curious relationship to the original "Kouma War" that devastated the city and sparked the formation of the Assault Force itself. 
Still operating in secret under the Grand Imperial Theater, the group still performs in sold-out operas and revues.

157879.overview: Yuki Gatari (雪語り) is an adventure game for the Sega Dreamcast.

157881.overview: Yuukyuu Gensoukyoku 3: Perpetual Blue (悠久幻想曲3 パーペチュアルブルー) is a simulation game for the Sega Dreamcast

177013.overview:
Omoide ni Kanata Kimi: Memories Off (想い出にかわる君 ~メモリーズオフ~, lit. You That Became a Memory ~Memories Off~) is a Japanese romance visual novel developed by KID for the Dreamcast and the PlayStation. It is the third game in the Memories Off series. The game was released for the Dreamcast and the PlayStation on September 27, 2001. It was later ported to the PlayStation 2 and PlayStation Portable. It was adapted into the first tale of an OVA series, titled as "Memories Off 3.5: Omoide no Kanata e".

Shougo is a lazy university student. He used to have a girlfriend called Kanata Kurosu, but one day she left him and he didn't know anything about her. One day, he meets her at the Cubic Cafe, Shougo's usual relax spot, and a new story beings...

181144.overview: Yume no Tsubasa: Fate of Heart (夢のつばさ 〜フエイトオブハート〜) is a visual novel for the Sega Dreamcast.

181145.overview: Yoshia no Oka de Nekoronde... is an adventure game for the Sega Dreamcast. The main character used to be a best-seller writer but lost the ability to write good stories after getting a disability. He decides to go to the hot springs resort to find his hidden self and try to get rid of his deficiency.

203678.overview: Four months after the events in Paris, Lieutenant Ichiro Ogami reunites with Flower Division of the Imperial Combat Revue. During that time a spirit breaks from imprisonment and begins terrorizing the city. The Flower division is forced to used their Kobus however, they forced to retreat to the Grand Imperial Theater, and Ogami is forced to call upon the help of the Paris Combat Revue.

219141.overview: Yukawa Moto Senmu no Otakara Sagashi is an Adventure game, developed by Yamaha and published by Sega, which was released in Japan in 1999.

446185.overview: Set in a fictionalized version of the Taishō period, the game follows the exploits of the Imperial Combat Revue, a military unit dedicated to fighting supernatural threats against Tokyo while maintaining their cover as a theater troupe. Imperial Japanese Navy Ensign Ichiro Ogami is assigned as leader of its all-female Flower Division, a group of women with magical abilities which defends Tokyo against demon attacks using steam-powered armor called Koubu. He becomes embroiled in both the group's latest conflict with the Hive of Darkness and the personal lives of its members.
